title: Revisit live forecast: pre-registration (written and hashed before any model call on these items)

snapshot.note: The snapshot files are not in the repository (150 MB); their SHA-256 are registered here. The time wall of every input is this snapshot.

population.rule: every (CVE, source package) undecided for bookworm in the snapshot: bookworm status open with no <no-dsa>/<postponed>/<ignored> mark, no bookworm DSA/DLA, label OPEN (core/build_events.py labels); packages linux, linux-*, chromium, firefox-esr, thunderbird, webkit2gtk, wpewebkit excluded as in every exam (forecast/build_forecast.py)

sample.method: population sorted by (CVE, package), shuffled with Python random.Random(seed); the first N in that order
sample.if_time_runs_out: items run in this order; at the stop time no new item starts; only the first K items of the order that have every prediction are sealed (K is reported); nothing after the first gap is sealed

arms.GATED: primary: the frozen product decision path. Evidence path (core/triage_agent.py run_S) + memory path (run_OURS, H-MEM loaded up to the snapshot) + the frozen gatekeeper core/gate.py over the two answers and H-MEM features (core/hmem_features.py); the same program as the sealed exam
arms.pkg_mode: baseline, no model: the package's most common decision in its history up to the snapshot (core/eval_core.py base_preds; NEXT when the package has no history)
arms.S: secondary, reported: the evidence path alone (computed anyway as part of GATED)
arms.OURS: secondary, reported: the memory path alone (computed anyway as part of GATED)

inputs.items: data/forecast_items.json (tracker description, bookworm version from the snapshot, limited support from security-support.deb12, no scope)
inputs.history: data/forecast_events.json (revisit3 recorded history 2026-06-01..2026-10-26 + label changes in the snapshot, dated with the snapshot day)

outcome.rule_short: urgent = bookworm fixed through bookworm-security (DSA/DLA); not urgent = <postponed>/<ignored>/<no-dsa>; undecided and other outcomes excluded and counted
outcome.rule: Read from the Debian security tracker JSON at verification time (scripts/verify_forecast.py). urgent: bookworm status resolved, its bookworm-security version at or above the fixed version and bookworm main below it (the fix reached bookworm through a DSA/DLA upload). not urgent: bookworm status open with a no-dsa mark (postponed, ignored or no-dsa). Excluded and counted: still undecided; decided another way (not affected, or fixed outside bookworm-security); no longer listed for bookworm.
outcome.prediction_mapping: a prediction is urgent when the arm answers URGENT; NEXT, WONTFIX and NOTAFF are not urgent

metrics.primary: urgent F1 and accuracy of each arm over the decided items, each with a 95% percentile bootstrap interval (2,000 resamples, seed 11)
metrics.small_sample: with fewer than 20 decided items the numbers are reported and no conclusion is drawn
metrics.no_gate: no pass/fail gate is registered; the forecast is published for anyone to verify

run.nightshift: every model call through Meterless Nightshift; one request in flight; meterless-scope iso-<uuid> per request, as in the sealed exam (with user scope Nightshift inserts earlier answers into the prompt, so the two paths would stop being independent)
run.model: nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b requested; the served model is logged per call
